stories.title: Buckley town centre flats above Mold Road shop refused by Flintshire planners
stories.summary: Plans to build six flats above an existing shop in Buckley town centre have been refused by Flintshire County Council. The application related to 1-3 Mold Road, on the junction with Padeswood Road, where the existing premises operate as an estate agency. stories.title: Wales has highest rate of young people not in work or study of any UK nation
stories.summary: 56,800 young people in Wales now classed as not in education, employment or training, up 18,500 in 12 months. stories.title: New poll shows Reform UK slightly ahead of Plaid Cymru in Senedd election
stories.summary: A new poll, conducted by Survation on behalf of Aberystwyth University and Newyddion S4C, places Reform UK slightly ahead of Plaid Cymru in voting intention ahead of the Senedd election.
